verdict.rationale: Paddle's own hosted MCP server has a codemode `execute` tool that runs a JavaScript function chaining one or more Paddle API calls in a single invocation. That lets an agent act on many items at once, but Paddle documents no dedicated bulk or batch endpoints or bulk-update features. Multi-item operation is therefore only implied by the scripting interface, not documented as a bulk capability. Missing for 10: documented bulk or batch API endpoints or dashboard bulk actions, documented limits or atomicity for multi-item operations, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
